clue.text: Put briefly, tot gets angry when about to get out of bed

parts.note: to tot up is to add, so a tot is a sum

indicators.note: MAD goes about, i.e. around, the next piece

parts.note: mad means angry
to rise is to get up from bed

explanation.surface: A toddler throws a tantrum when made to get up in the morning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tot' looks like a small child but means an added-up total; 'when' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To summarise something is to state it concisely, in a few words.

clue.text: Beastly home of crossword compiler a third demolished

indicators.note: one third of a six-letter word is two letters, here the last two knocked off

parts.note: the person who sets a crossword is its setter

explanation.surface: A puzzle-maker's house is partly knocked down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a third demolished' removes ER, two of the six letters of SETTER.
explanation.definitionFit: A badger's burrow is called by that name, so it is an animal's home.

clue.text: Like a lodge, with mum in charge protecting her boy

indicators.note: MA and IC wrap round and shield the boy's letters

parts.note: Ma is an informal word for mum
a mother's boy is her son

explanation.surface: A household in which a mother in authority shelters her son, like a sheltered home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lodge' is not a cabin but a Freemasons' branch.
explanation.definitionFit: Freemasons meet in lodges, so something relating to them is lodge-like.

clue.text: Rebuke hot men involved with mad sin

indicators.note: involved suggests the letters are tangled together and rearranged

explanation.surface: A telling-off for lustful men caught up in reckless sin.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebuke and an admonishment are both a reprimand or scolding.

clue.text: Available numbers turning up, pursuing home on the waves

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece placed on another sits above it
pursuing means coming after, so this piece follows the others

parts.note: in means at home
the waves stand for the sea

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up means the word reads from bottom to top

explanation.surface: Something about numbers rising while chasing home across the sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning up' reverses NOS to SON; 'on' and 'pursuing' fix the order IN, SEA, SON.
explanation.definitionFit: Produce in season is currently obtainable in the shops, as fresh food is.

clue.text: See, in Devon, old tree crashing

parts.note: ex- means former or old

indicators.note: a crashing tree is smashed apart, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Look at an ancient tree falling down in a West Country county.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' is not 'look' but a bishop's seat; 'crashing' rearranges TREE to ETER. Devon is a county in south-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: A see is a bishop's diocese, and this Devon cathedral city is the seat of one.

clue.text: Ruler in Bundestag hated

indicators.note: in shows the letters lie inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A leader in the German parliament who is disliked.
explanation.definitionFit: An Ottoman title for a commander or chief, so a ruler.

clue.text: Good to discover the truth about beef

parts.note: to rumble someone is to see through them and find them out

explanation.surface: Finding out the truth about meat is a good thing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beef' is not meat here but a verb or noun meaning complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: Beef is slang for a complaint, and a grumble is a complaint.

clue.text: Prepared to be plundering supply of cash?

definitions.meaning: the ready is slang for money, so being at it suggests raiding the cash

explanation.surface: A robber prepared to raid the money supply.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means poised and prepared for action, as a gun held ready to fire.

clue.text: Demanding supervisor marks a test unreasonably

indicators.note: unreasonably suggests the letters are put in a disordered arrangement

explanation.surface: A strict boss is harsh in grading an exam.
explanation.definitionFit: A taskmaster is someone who sets hard work and demands it be done, a strict overseer.

clue.text: Simply fair

definitions.meaning: merely, only, as in 'simply a moment'
equitable and right, as a fair ruling

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both merely and righteous, two unrelated senses.

clue.text: Lady protects terrible old creatures

indicators.note: terrible suggests the letters are in a dreadful mess, so rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman guards awful elderly beasts.
explanation.definitionFit: These were prehistoric flying reptiles, creatures long extinct.

clue.text: Before long minister will disown leader

indicators.note: the word gives up its first letter

parts.note: a canon is a clergyman, a minister of a cathedral

explanation.surface: Soon a clergyman will reject the head of his church.
explanation.definitionFit: An old word for soon or shortly, so in a little while.

clue.text: Board backing state? That can be avoided

indicators.note: the board backs the state, standing behind it

parts.note: to aver is to state or assert
a table is a board, as in board and lodging

explanation.surface: A company board supporting a particular state's policy.
explanation.definitionFit: To avert something is to ward it off, so this is preventable.

clue.text: Newspaper office changed in this period?

indicators.note: changed signals the letters are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: A newspaper's top job changed hands during this time.
explanation.definitionFit: The post of being in charge of a paper's content is an office in the sense of a position.

clue.text: Judgement of City is one accepted by academic

indicators.note: the academic takes in the other letters

parts.note: a don is a university lecturer
EC is the postcode for the City of London
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A court ruling that a city is accepted by a university scholar.
explanation.walkthrough: The City of London is its historic financial district, whose postal code begins EC.
explanation.definitionFit: A judgement is a ruling or conclusion reached, which is a decision.

clue.text: Church stands against endless avarice in country

indicators.note: the church is placed up against, beside, the previous piece
the word loses its last letter

parts.note: avarice is greed
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: The church opposes unending greed in the nation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stands against' reads as opposition but means placed alongside.
explanation.definitionFit: A nation in south-eastern Europe.

clue.text: Put off and fed up, having made mistake

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read from the bottom

parts.note: to err is to make a mistake

explanation.surface: Postponed, and sick of it, after getting something wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fed up' looks like 'annoyed', but 'up' reverses FED to DEF.
explanation.definitionFit: Something put off has been postponed to a later time.

clue.text: A market suffering setback — you finally admitted emotional shock

indicators.note: the reversed letters take in the final letter
a setback turns the words back, so they read in reverse

parts.note: a mart is a market

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: A market's downturn leaves you emotionally shaken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suffering setback' reverses A MART to TRAMA, which admits U.
explanation.definitionFit: Trauma is a deeply distressing experience, a psychological shock.

clue.text: Version of story that bank may offer

definitions.meaning: a narrative or report of events
a bank holds money for a customer in one of these

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a report of events and a customer's banking arrangement.

clue.text: Place from which to look out to sea as one who leads country

definitions.text: Place from which to look out to sea

parts.note: a head is a leader, as of a school
a land is a country

explanation.surface: A national leader surveys the ocean from a coastal vantage point.
explanation.definitionFit: A promontory jutting into the sea gives a view out over the water.

clue.text: Unknown character about to enter a drowned valley somewhere in USA

indicators.note: the other letters go into the A and valley

parts.note: a ria is a river valley flooded by the sea
in algebra Z is an unknown
on means concerning or about

explanation.surface: A mysterious person about to go into a flooded valley in America.
explanation.walkthrough: ZON goes inside ARIA, between RI and A.
explanation.definitionFit: A state in the south-western United States.

clue.text: Energy very reduced — I work, then start to unwind, right?

parts.note: very cut down to its abbreviation is V
go means work, as a machine does

indicators.note: start picks the first letter

explanation.surface: Someone tired out who works, then begins to relax.
explanation.definitionFit: Vigour is physical strength and energy, vitality.

clue.text: Obscure journalist admits trick in formal practice

indicators.note: the journalist's letters go in the practice

parts.note: a rite is a ceremonial practice

indicators.note: the editor lets in the trick

parts.note: ED, short for editor, is a journalist
a con is a trick or swindle

explanation.surface: A writer confesses to cheating during a ceremony.
explanation.walkthrough: Two containers nest: the trick goes inside the journalist, and that pair goes inside the practice, giving ECOND inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Recondite means little known, abstruse, hard to understand.

clue.text: Cold joint and a bit of fried potato

parts.note: the hip is a joint

explanation.surface: A cold roast meat joint served with fries.
explanation.walkthrough: 'joint' suggests meat, but it is the hip.
explanation.definitionFit: A chip is a strip of deep-fried potato.

clue.text: Poke gently with stick

definitions.meaning: a pointed rod used for jabbing, as a cattle goad

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the act of nudging and the pointed instrument used for it.

clue.text: Period house to the west of ancient city

indicators.note: in an across clue west is the left, so this comes first

parts.note: Ur was a city in ancient Mesopotamia

explanation.surface: A historical building lying west of an old city.
explanation.definitionFit: Sixty minutes is a period of time.

clue.text: Sixteen, we deduce, in sturdy vehicle

definitions.meaning: four multiplied by four makes sixteen
an off-road vehicle with drive to all four wheels

explanation.definitionFit: The term names a four-wheel-drive vehicle and also the multiplication giving sixteen.

clue.text: Way female poet has expunged line

indicators.note: the poet's name has a letter wiped out

parts.note: Sylvia Plath was an American poet

explanation.surface: A woman poet cut a line from her verse.
explanation.definitionFit: A way is a route or track to follow.

clue.text: Female going to match travels with mother in advance

indicators.note: the travel and mother go in the advance

parts.note: a bid is an advance or offer
rides means travels
ma is mother

explanation.surface: A woman goes ahead with her mother to a sporting fixture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'match' is not a game but a wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: She attends a bride at a wedding, the match in question.
